title: Patchnotes card front matter
description: The YAML block at the top of a card file (SPEC.md § 5.4). The body below it holds the fixed sections, each marked with its anchor: {#summary}, {#what_changes}, {#who}, {#when}, {#what_to_do}, {#details}.

lang.description: One of patchnotes.languages; never hardcoded anywhere (§ 24.15).

master_hash.description: Hash of the master card this translation was made from. When it no longer matches, the translation is stale and is re-queued (§ 5.4).

translation.description: Machine translations carry a badge on the website; only the German law text is binding.

translated_by.description: Model in "provider:model-id" form, or a person.
